tom-recruiter: Quick Q — Anita (start 2026-06-01). Spouse filed H4 EAD renewal ~3 weeks ago, receipt issued but no SSN yet. Candidate asked if spouse can be added to medical at day 1. cc @emily-peopleops @kevin-hiringmgr
emily-peopleops: In most cases vendors accept the I-797C receipt for initial enrollment but they will require SSN once available. I'll need copies of the receipt + marriage cert. Which vendor (Aetna vs Cigna) are we on for this group?
anita-newhire: Thanks! I uploaded the receipt, marriage cert, and spouse passport to the candidate drive: https://drive.company/boxed/anita/imm. Receipt number ends in 9876. We're on Aetna, I believe.
imm-legal: From legal: Aetna typically allows provisional dependent enrollments with a USCIS receipt notice; document the receipt in the employee file and collect SSN/EAD card when issued. If EAD denied, revoke dependent coverage per plan terms. Keep the timeline notes.
emily-peopleops: Good. Two operational notes: 1) benefits vendor will need a "pending SSN" flag; 2) payroll will still deduct premiums even without SSN and may process retro adjustments later. @payroll-bot can you confirm payroll handling and whether we can front employer share for initial pay period(s)?
payroll-bot: @emily-peopleops Payroll note: premiums will start on first payroll after enrollment. If SSN arrives later and vendor applies retro charges/refunds, payroll will net adjustments on the following cycle. We can approve covering employer portion for up to 2 pay periods (approx. 1 month) as an exception; please route approval through finance if >2 periods.
emily-peopleops: Thanks — proposing we cover employer portion for up to 2 pay periods to avoid delaying start. @kevin-hiringmgr any objections?
kevin-hiringmgr: No objections. We want Anita onboard on schedule. Approve covering employer share for up to 2 pay periods.
anita-newhire: Appreciate it. One more thing: if the EAD is approved after start, do I upload a scanned EAD + SSN to the same drive or email benefits@redwood?
emily-peopleops: Upload to the same drive and please also email benefits@redwood with subject line "Anita - dependent SSN/EAD" so vendor gets notified. We'll update the vendor record and payroll.
imm-legal: Also keep a short audit note in the HRIS: "Provisional dependent enrollment w/ USCIS receipt dated [receipt date]; SSN pending. Employer covering employer portion up to 2 pay periods." We'll keep that for compliance.
payroll-bot: Noted. Payroll will wait for vendor reconciliation before altering employee paycheck records. If a retro premium is charged to employee and we approved employer cover, payroll will process reimbursement in the next cycle.
tom-recruiter: I'll message Anita and confirm she uploads the EAD/SSN if/when issued and that her start date remains 2026-06-01.
emily-peopleops: I'll open the Aetna case now and post the vendor case number here by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
anita-newhire: Thank you all! :heart:
